summary: Manual extraction for rakudai-kishi-main vol-03. The volume opens with Shizuku's childhood motive for loving and following Ikki, then follows her B-rank selection duel against Hagun's strongest student, Toka Todo. Toka defeats Shizuku with Reverse Sight, Nuk足 and Raikiri, while Shizuku's defeat deepens her ties to Alice and Stella. Ikki and Stella then help the student council investigate the supposed Okutama giant; Stella falls ill, Ikki cares for her, and they discuss intimacy and eventually meeting both families. The giant proves to be a remote stone-puppet attack tied to Akatsuki; Toka destroys the relay puppet and injures the unseen puppeteer, while Ouma Kurogane is foreshadowed. Akaza and Itsuki then exploit a leaked kiss photo to manufacture a scandal, detain Ikki through the Ethics Committee, drug and exhaust him, and force a final duel with Toka. After Itsuki's hierarchy doctrine shatters Ikki's remaining faith in his birth family, Shizuku, Stella and many Hagun students give him the support needed to reach the arena. Ikki challenges Toka's Raikiri head-on, evolves Ittou Shura into the single-instant Ittou Rasetsu, shatters Narukami, and becomes a Seven Stars representative under the title Uncrowned Sword King. The epilogue appoints Hagun's representatives, makes Ikki captain, resolves the public scandal pressure through the Vermillion king's displeasure, opens the national stage, and reveals Alice/Nagi as Akatsuki's Black Rose.
